item: Row 367 batch 1: Settings import, newsletter and storage lines follow a language switch
key_paths: src/static/app-settings.js; src/static/app-core.js; configs/i18n_frozen_renderers.txt; src/static/locales/*.json; tests/settings_imports_live_node_test.js; tests/test_settings_imports_live.py; tests/test_oo_live.py
summary: Eleven frozen renderers in app-settings.js (importNewsletters, undoNewsletterAttach, importPdfs, importPdfFolder, _folderImportRefresh, loadNewsletterRemoveCount, removeImportedNewsletters, pullMailbox, saveImportCheckpointK, loadLaneStorage, saveLaneBudget) now draw through ooLive/ooLiveHtml from state they already hold, so a language switch redraws them with no request; their 11 lines leave configs/i18n_frozen_renderers.txt. Four keyed sentences x12 replace welds: the remove-panel count and the move-back line as plurals, the folder import's running and done lines as labelled counts. Also fixed: pullMailbox wrote esc() output as text (an & read &), and loadLaneStorage left _laneStorageLast set after a failed read so a language switch drew the old table over the error. Driven as real code by settings_imports_live_node_test.js. ooLive (app-core.js) now keeps a text render and an HTML render under separate names on separate paths, so what an ooLive render returns can only reach textContent; with one shared render field a static reader traced a form value drawn as text into the innerHTML write (CodeQL on this PR), pinned in tests/test_oo_live.py.
